name: blunted
description: Private local writing-clarity app — offline engine, no accounts, no network.

scripts.build:tauri: npm run build && npm run bundle:tauri && tauri build
scripts.build:tauri:mac: npm run build && npm run bundle:tauri && tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles dmg
scripts.build:tauri:win: npm run build && npm run bundle:tauri && tauri build --bundles nsis
